description: This Java class provides services for processing payments through SecurePay, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit operations. It interacts with SecurePay API and OFBiz framework components.

classes.name: SecurePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing payment operations via SecurePay API within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: doAuth
methods.description: Performs authorization of a payment through SecurePay.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Placeholder for credit card re-authorization, currently returns success.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a previously authorized or captured payment.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a payment.

methods.name: doCredit
methods.description: Performs a credit operation, typically a refund or chargeback.

methods.name: buildScProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for SecurePay API from the database or properties files.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values for SecurePay from the database or properties files.
